caption: Development world 7102, by day. Shading is probability per square metre of open ground, darker is likelier; buildings brown, the geofence dashed. The person (wander, 15 m from the last known point) was confirmed after 40 s by the probability search and after 786 s by the shipped lane sweep. On the right, the ground the camera has looked at is pale: the frames have searched its probability away.
